params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'list' below is an object name (string) referring to a form representation of the list; if omitted, 'list' is a hierarchical list reference number (ListRef).

params.name: list
params.description: List reference number (if '*' omitted), or name of the list-type form object (if '*' passed).

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item appended to the list (via APPEND TO LIST)
the current item of the list (requires the object-name syntax, since each form representation can have its own current item)
reapply the default font of the hierarchical list

interactionNotes.note: The literal symbol '*' means two unrelated things depending on position: leading = 'list is a name, not a ref number'; in itemRef's slot = 'operate on the current item'. Using the itemRef '*' sentinel requires the object-name syntax (leading '*' passed).
